title: RIDE-AWAY CORPORATION: RIDE-AWAY/REAR AXLE (17 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CONVERSION VANS.  THE REAR AXLE CAN HIT THE FUEL FILLER HOSE CAUSING IT TO DISCONNECT FROM THE FUEL TANK, SPILLING FUEL ONTO THE GROUND.

title: ACCURIDE CORPORATION: ACCURIDE/WHEEL RIM CRACKS (5,719 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  22.5 X 8.25 15  TUBELESS DEMOUNTABLE RIMS, PART NO. 32051, MANUFACTURED BETWEEN JANUARY 25 AND MARCH 3, 2000.  CERTAIN RIMS CONTAIN A NON-FUSION AREA IN THE BUTT-WELD OF THE MOUNTING RING.  UNDER CERTAIN CIRCUMSTANCES, THE DEFECT COULD DEVELOP INTO A CRACK ON THE MOUNTING RING.

title: Triumph Motorcycles America, Ltd.: TRIUMPH/CLUTCH HOUSING BOLTS (763 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MOTORCYCLES.  THE BOLTS SECURING THE ALTERNATOR ROTOR TO SPRAG CLUTCH COULD BECOME LOOSE DUE TO INAPPROPRIATE ASSEMBLY METHOD.

title: Brake Parts Inc.: BRAKE PARTS/MASTER CYLINDERS (3,149 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER PART NUMBERS 390275, 390377, MC390275, MC390337, E151360, E150614, 18M801, AND 18M739 MANUFACTURED BETWEEN APRIL 1998 AND APRIL 2000.  THESE MASTER CYLINDERS HAVE AN INCORRECTLY MOLDED BRAKE FLUID RESERVOIR.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/FMVSS 209/SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES (1,167 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES USING AFTERMARKET DRIVER'S SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES THAT WERE SOLD BY FORD PARTS DEPARTMENTS FROM JANUARY 1,  THROUGH JUNE 13, 2000.  THESE SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 209, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES."  THE EQUIPMENT INVOLVED IS SERVICE STOCK SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES, MODEL NOS. H 9977, H 9979, T 9063, AND T 9217, BUILT BY TRW VEHICLE SAFETY SYSTEMS, INC. (TRW)  MANUFACTURED FROM JUNE 1, 1998 THROUGH MAY 21, 2000.    SOME OF THESE SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED AS SERVICE REPLACEMENT EQUIPMENT ON THE VEHICLES INVOLVED IN THE RECALL.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/FMVSS 209/SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES (1,129 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES USING AFTERMARKET FRONT PASSENGER SIDE SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES THAT WERE SOLD BY FORD PARTS DEPARTMENTS FROM JANUARY 1,  THROUGH JUNE 13, 2000.  THESE SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 209, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES."  THE EQUIPMENT INVOLVED IS SERVICE STOCK SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES, MODEL NOS. H 9977, H 9979, T 9063, AND T 9217, BUILT BY TRW VEHICLE SAFETY SYSTEMS, INC. (TRW)  MANUFACTURED FROM JUNE 1, 1998 THROUGH MAY 21, 2000.    SOME OF THESE SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED AS SERVICE REPLACEMENT EQUIPMENT ON THE VEHICLES INVOLVED IN THE RECALL.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BLUE BIRD/BENDIX AIR BRAKE VALVE (9,687 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SCHOOL AND TRANSIT BUSES EQUIPPED WITH BENDIX AIR BRAKES.  BENDIX CHANGED THE INTERNAL DESIGN OF THE QR1C RELAY VALVE BY ADDING A HOLE IN THE INTERNAL DIAPHRAGM.  WHEN THE HOLE IN THE DIAPHRAGM ALIGNS WITH THE HOLE IN THE VALVE BODY, THE BRAKE APPLICATION TIME INCREASES.

title: SUPERLIFT SUSPENSION SYSTEMS: SUPERLIFT SUSPENSION/STEERING CENTERLINK (515 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  AFTERMARKET REPLACEMENT STEERING CENTERLINK ARM PART NO. 55-06-9600 MANUFACTURED BETWEEN APRIL 17, 1997 AND MARCH 1, 2000.  THE STEERING CENTERLINK CAN BREAK IN THE AREA WHERE THE PITMAN ARM ATTACHES.

title: Trailers by Dorsey, Inc.: DORSEY/BUSTIN TRAILER LADDER (210 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  INSULATED VANS WITH BUSTIN PULLOUT TRUCK/TRAILER LADDER PART NOS. DE1903-A AND DE1905-A.  THE CROSS BAR THAT SUPPORTS THE STEP FAILS WHEN WELDS THAT ATTACH IT TO THE SQUARE TUBE SIDE SUPPORTS FAIL.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/BRAKE PIPE (306 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  ELECTRIC PICKUP TRUCKS.  A CONDITION IN WHICH THE FUEL-FIRED HEATER FILL PIPE GROUND STRAP CONTACTS THE REAR PASSENGER SIDE BRAKE PIPE.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/FMVSS 301/FUEL FILL HOSE CLAMP (248 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:   PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE CLAMP THAT SECURES THE FLEXIBLE FUEL FILL HOSE TO THE METAL FILL TUBE MAY BE LOOSE AND COULD SEPARATE.

title: BUELL-out of business: BUELL/REAR SHOCK ABSORBER (6,219 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:    MOTORCYCLES.  THE REAR SHOCK ABSORBER CAN BREAK, DRAGGING THE UNDERSIDE OF THE VEHICLE ON THE GROUND.

title: Britax Child Safety, Inc.: BRITAX/FMVSS 213 HARNESS ADJUSTER (9,922 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  ROUNDABOUT CONVERTIBLE CHILD RESTRAINTS, MODEL 161, MANUFACTURED BETWEEN JANUARY 13 AND MARCH 14, 1999.  THE SHELLS MANUFACTURED DURING THIS TIME MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY MOLDED AND COULD ALLOW HIGHER HEAD EXCURSIONS THAN ALLOWED BY FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 213, "CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEMS."  AN INSUFFICIENT PARTING LINE BOND IN THE AREA OF THE HARNESS ADJUSTER ATTACHMENT MAY LEAD TO ADJUSTER MOVEMENT UNDER CRASH LOADS THAT COULD ALLOW A CHILD'S HEAD TO MOVE FURTHER THAN THE PERMITTED LIMITS.

title: Aprilia USA, Inc.: APRILIA/REAR AXLE (27 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MOTORCYCLES WITH FAIRINGS.  THE REAR AXLE COULD FAIL, CAUSING THE REAR WHEEL TO WOBBLE OR JAM.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/FUEL LINE FITTINGS (3,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MINI VANS.  THESE VEHICLES MAY HAVE INCORRECTLY FUEL LINE END FORMS WHICH COULD RESULT IN A LOWER THAN SPECIFIED PULL APART FORCE FOR THE INSTALLED FUEL LINE CONNECTION.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/FMVSS 108/DAYTIME RUNNING LIGHTS (20,637 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MINI VANS, LIGHT PICKUP TRUCKS, AND SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES.  OFF LEASE CANADIAN VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH DAYTIME RUNNING LIGHTS WHICH MEET CANADIAN REQUIREMENTS AND NOT THE PHOTOMETRIC REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."  ACCORDING TO FORD, THE VEHICLES WERE IMPORTED INTO THE U.S. ERRONEOUSLY.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/BRAKE PEDAL/MASTER CYLINDER CLIP (8,100 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  F-SUPER DUTY STRIPPED MOTOR HOME CHASSIS BECAUSE THEY MAY HAVE A MISSING OR PARTIALLY INSTALLED BRAKE PEDAL TO MASTER CYLINDER PUSHROD RETAINING CLIP.

title: Jayco, Inc.: JAYCO/TRAILER HITCH (760 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  23' TRAVEL TRAILERS.  THE DESIGN INCORPORATES ALL OF THE LIQUID STORAGE TANKS BEHIND THE AXLE, SO THAT WHEN THE TANKS ARE FULL OR OTHER MATERIALS ARE IMPROPERLY LOADED, TRAILER HITCH WEIGHT IS REDUCED.

title: COACHMEN INDUSTRIES, INC.: COACHMEN/ELECTRICAL WIRING (117 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CLASS C MOTOR HOMES CONSTRUCTED ON CHEVY CHASSIS.   THE ROUTING OF THE MAIN BATTERY FEED WIRING FROM THE COACH BATTERY TO THE DISTRIBUTION PANEL OF THE MOTOR HOME.  THE COACH BATTERY IS NOT THE ENGINE BATTERY.  THE COACH BATTERY PROVIDES SERVICE TO THE MOTOR HOME'S 12V APPLIANCES.  THE ROUTING ALLOWS IT TO COME IN CONTACT WITH THE EXHAUST MANIFOLD OF THE VEHICLE, AND OVER TIME, THE HEAT OF THE MANIFOLD DEGRADES THE SHIELDING OF THE WIRE EXPOSING THE WIRE TO THE METAL MANIFOLD.

title: SAFARI MOTOR COACHES, INC.: SAFARI/ABS MODULATOR (691 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION: 1999 AND 2000  MOTOR HOMES MANUFACTURED BETWEEN APRIL 2 AND NOVEMBER 20, 1999, AND EQUIPPED WITH ABS SYSTEMS WITH BRAKE WIRING HARNESS PART #2505168.  THE ELECTRICAL CONNECTOR WHICH CONNECTS TO THE MODULATOR WAS MIS-WIRED CAUSING THE ANTI-LOCK BRAKE MODULATOR TO REACT IMPROPERLY WHILE REGULATING HYDRAULIC PRESSURE TO THE APPROPRIATE WHEEL.

title: S&S CYCLE INC: S&S CYCLE/INTAKE MANIFOLD (3,196 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  S&S V2 STYLE 2 1/16" INTAKE MANIFOLDS PART NOS. 16-2500 AND 16-2520 MANUFACTURED BETWEEN OCTOBER 1, 1999 AND MARCH 31, 2000.  PROGRESSIVE WEAR OF THE CAST MANIFOLDS PERMITTED AN EXCESS AMOUNT OF MATERIAL ON THE OUTER SURFACE WHICH PRESENTS INSUFFICIENT CLEARANCE BETWEEN THE MANIFOLD AND THE CARBURETOR SPOOL.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: THOMAS BUILT/HEADLIGHT (803 affected)
summary: CERTAIN SCHOOL BUSES WITH WELDON TECHNOLOGIES' 5050-1400 SURFACE MOUNT MARKER LIGHTS HAVE AN OPTION TO REPLACE EACH OF THE TWELVE CLEARANCE/MARKER/IDENTIFICATION LIGHTS WITH FOUR-CANDLEPOWER LIGHTS, TWICE THE CANDLEPOWER NORMALLY USED.  THE HIGHER CURRENT DEMAND CREATED BY THESE LIGHTS CAN CAUSE EXCESSIVE HEAT THROUGH THE HEADLIGHT SWITCH CONNECTION IF A RELAY IS NOT INSTALLED BETWEEN THE COMBINATION TAIL/MARKER LIGHT CIRCUIT AND THE HEADLIGHT SWITCH.

title: Children's Picnic Sets Recalled by Mervyn's
summary: The paint on the bag contains high levels of lead that violates the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Act. Lead poisoning in children is associated with behavior problems, learning disabilities, hearing problems and growth retardation. Units: About 1,200.

title: Grinders Recalled by S-B Power Tool
summary: Some grinders were shipped without the side handle, which is used to control and guide the tool. Use of the grinder without the side handle can cause consumers to lose control of the tool and be injured. Units: About 920.

title: CPSC, Jetmax International Ltd. Announce Recall to Repair Children's Rocking Chairs Sold at Target Stores
summary: The rear legs of the chair can separate from the rocker's base, causing it to collapse, and the child seated in the chair can fall. Units: About 48,000.

title: CPSC, Graco Announce Recall to Repair Tot Wheels® Entertainer® Infant Walkers
summary: These walkers can collapse unexpectedly during use and injure infants. Units: About 31,000.

title: CPSC, Ace Hardware Corp. Announce Recall of Vinyl Window Blinds
summary: These blinds contain lead exceeding government guidelines, and do not have required labeling warning they contain lead. Over time, vinyl deteriorates from exposure to sunlight and heat, forming lead dust on the surface of the blind. Young children can ingest lead by wiping their hands on the blinds

title: Playtex Products Voluntarily Announces Pacifier Recall in Cooperation with CPSC
summary: Because the latex is aging faster than normal, the nipple can detach from the shield, presenting a choking hazard to babies. Units: About 1.8 million.

title: CPSC, Federated Department Stores Announce Recall of Children's Robes
summary: These robes, when used as sleepwear, fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear. title: CPSC, Promotional Resources Group Announce Recall of Bug Zapper Toys Sold With Children's Meals
summary: The balloon tongue on this toy can detach, posing a choking and aspiration hazard to young children. Units: About 105,000.

title: Infant Cargo Skirts Recalled by Associated Merchandising Corp.
summary: The snaps on the panty of these skirts can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 9,500.

title: Sweatshirts Recalled by Jordache Ltd.
summary: The sweatshirts, which fail to meet federal mandatory standards for fabric flammability, could ignite easily and present a serious risk of burn injuries, in violation of the Federal Flammable Fabrics Act. Fabrics that do not comply with the standard typically burn faster than newspaper. Units: About

title: CPSC, Kellogg Company Announce Recall of Toy Cars Inside Boxes of Cereal
summary: The tires can detach from the wheels of these cars, posing a choking hazard for young children. Units: 837,000.

title: CPSC, Whitehall-Robins Healthcare Announce Recall of Teething Rings
summary: When bent, these teething rings can fit into an infant's mouth and trigger a gagging reflex. This poses a risk of vomiting, which could result in choking and aspiration. Units: About 475,000.

title: CPSC and Tanaka Announce Recall of Hedge Trimmers and Augers
summary: The fuel tank vents on these products can leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 7,500 hedge trimmers and 1,400 augers.

title: CPSC, Apollo Presentation Products Announce Recall of Light Boxes
summary: The light boxes have loose wires and lack adequate grounding, presenting fire, electrocution and shock hazards to consumers. Units: About 30,000.

title: CPSC, Galoob Toys Inc. Announce Recall of Sky Dancers® Flying Dolls
summary: The hard plastic Sky Dancers® dolls can fly rapidly in unpredictable directions, and can hit and injure both children and adults. Units: About 8.9 million.

title: CPSC, Today's Kids Announce Recall of Spinning Ride Toys
summary: The center column can break, causing a child to suddenly fall backward or be hit in the face by the broken column. Units: About 103,000.

title: CPSC, Vtech Industries Announce Recall of Toy Baby Phone
summary: The toy phones have a ball-shaped antenna, which can detach, presenting a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 34,000.
